articles.title: Race Cars Zoom Past Washington Monuments!
articles.summary: President Trump and his wife will watch IndyCar race through D.C. streets. Cars go almost 200 mph! It's part of America's 250th birthday party.

articles.title: Another Storm Heads to Hawaii!
articles.summary: Tropical Storm Moke is bringing more rain to Hawaii after Hurricane Lala. Up to 15 inches of rain could fall. People are preparing for more flooding.

articles.title: Saudi Prince Visits Paris for Big Talks
articles.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman is in Paris to meet with French President Macron. They'll talk about energy, conflicts, and maybe sign agreements.
